package.name: biguasim_bringup
package.description: Orchestration only, no code of its own. Starts a BiguaSim world and (optionally) the biguasim_bridge normalizers, the biguasim_sensor_check monitor and RViz2. How BiguaSim itself is launched is a parameter (biguasim_cmd) because it depends on how install_biguasim.sh installed it -- see biguasim.launch.py and config/biguasim.yaml.
